description: Every environment variable the backend reads, where it is read, and what breaks when it is missing. Verified by grepping os.getenv/os.environ across backend/app.py, backend/db.py, backend/routes/pdf.py, backend/migrate_to_postgres.py.

critical.name: DATABASE_URL
critical.missing_behaviour: get_db_connection() raises on an unusable URL; db.py:21-33 retries with sslmode=prefer then sslmode=disable before failing
notes: Read ONCE at import time, so changing it requires a process restart.
db.py:7 calls load_dotenv(override=True), so a stale local .env OVERRIDES the platform-injected value on Render.

critical.name: SECRET_KEY
critical.missing_behaviour: Falls back to the literal string "your_secret_key". Every session cookie becomes forgeable by anyone who knows this default.
notes: Guards the session cookie signature, which carries username, active role, and must_change_password.

critical.name: CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME
critical.missing_behaviour: cloudinary.config() raises AttributeError at import time (backend/app.py:41-47 is not guarded), which prevents the app from starting.

ai_providers.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
ai_providers.fallback: Summaries are skipped and the worklog is returned unsummarised

ai_providers.name: NVIDIA_API_KEY
ai_providers.used_by: secondary AI provider, paired with NVIDIA_MODEL_NAME

smtp.name: SMTP_PORT
smtp.note: A non-numeric value raises ValueError at import time

smtp.name: SMTP_EMAIL
smtp.used_by: sender identity; falls back to SENDER_EMAIL at :138

smtp.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
smtp.note: Gmail app password, not the account password

smtp.name: AQAR_COORDINATOR_EMAILS
smtp.used_by: selects the AQAR coordinator variant of the AQAR PDF
smtp.note: At backend/routes/pdf.py:1103 a single email also matches a single NAME entry

smtp.name: AQAR_COORDINATOR_NAMES
smtp.used_by: signature block on the AQAR PDF

hardcoded_secrets_and_pii.issue: Hardcoded recipient in the AQAR sign-off recipient list, in addition to the env-configured list
A PERSONAL gmail address hardcoded alongside the institutional one. Should be removed or moved to AQAR_COORDINATOR_EMAILS.

dev_only.name: LOCAL_SQLITE
dev_only.issue: Not an env var in practice. A bare relative filename resolved against os.getcwd(). Running the script from the wrong directory silently migrates nothing yet still prints success.

not_used_but_assumed.name: FLASK_ENV / FLASK_DEBUG
not_used_but_assumed.status: not read anywhere in the codebase
not_used_but_assumed.note: Debug mode is never programmatically enabled; use flask run --debug locally

not_used_but_assumed.name: SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE / SAMESITE
not_used_but_assumed.status: never set; app.config is never assigned
not_used_but_assumed.note: Flask 3.0 defaults apply: HTTPONLY=True, SECURE=False, no SameSite attribute. See session storage in backend/03-authentication.md.
